name: Utatte Shimatta Kanzaki-kun
original_name: 歌ってしまった神崎くん
source:
You're an ordinary high school senior who has transferred schools due to family circumstances. You're average at most and don't have any special talents, so you haven't decided what you want to do in the future.

It's Kanzaki Hajime, who sits next to you, who approaches you.
"If you have any problems, just ask me."

He's an excellent student, kind to everyone, and has already decided on his future path. A perfect person in every way. 

The school life of two completely opposite people begins.
